summary: Wave 100 verified end-to-end. critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py:1762 — sb_admin.table('users').delete().eq('id', user_id).execute() runs BEFORE sb_admin.auth.admin.delete_user(user_id). If the auth delete fails (network blip, Supabase outage) the public.users row is already gone, leaving an orphan Auth user that can never log in (no users row to map back). Reverse the order — delete Auth user first, then public.users — so a partial failure leaves data consistent and re-runnable.

routes/admin.py:1693-1733 — /admin/users hard-caps at 2000 rows with no pagination. UsersTab.jsx renders all rows in one HTML table. At >2k users this will be slow + the cap silently truncates. Add ?page=&limit= server-side and pagination/virtualization client-side before user count grows.

routes/admin.py:1736 — DELETE has no idempotency / no audit-log entry. Other admin destructive actions go through _log_admin_action; admin user deletion should too (especially since the email becomes free to re-register — this is high-risk).

Phase2Banner.jsx:30 MANDATORY_DOCS hard-codes 4 doc keys; the banner-bug fix relies on this list being exhaustive. If a future migration adds a new mandatory doc (e.g. MSME cert) the banner will silently mark dealers as complete. Move the list to a backend-driven /api/dealer/required-docs endpoint or at least a single shared constants module imported by both server.py and Phase2Banner.jsx.

Register.jsx — the account_type required validation runs on submit only; no live error clearing when the user does pick a card afterwards. Minor UX: clear errors.account_type when an account-type card is clicked.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 100 backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_wave100_users_panel.py (6 cases, ~28s, requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env). Key Wave 100 facts: (1) /api/auth/signup-supplier.business_address is now Optional (server.py:235,270); (2) /api/admin/dealers/bulk-create catches Supabase 'user_already_exists' errors and pushes them to skipped_existing rather than failed (admin.py:1610-1611); (3) /api/admin/users returns {users:[…],count:N} with is_protected=True for any user whose id appears in suppliers (admin.py:1731); (4) DELETE /api/admin/users/{uid} returns 403 for approved dealers and 200 for everyone else, cascading to suppliers_pending, user_agreements, saved_addresses, users, then Supabase Auth (admin.py:1749-1769). rca of the issue: No defects found. The previous-wave QA pattern of using '@example.test' emails was kept switched to '@example.com' to avoid Pydantic EmailStr reserved-TLD rejection. /api/auth/signup-customer accepts personal-buyer fields (email/password/name/phone/user_type); supplier signup accepts contact_person + phone with optional business_address. Bulk reclassification works because Supabase's create_user raises 'user_already_exists' which routes/admin.py:1610 catches via 'already'/'exists'/'duplicate' substring match — robust against minor wording changes from Supabase.
